mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_completion_record (workspace_id, task_id, title, description, req_id, req_name, req_doc_id, req_doc_title, owner, owner_user_id, category, priority, start_date, completed_at, first_started_at, last_ended_at, total_minutes) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{taskId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{reqId}, #{reqName}, #{reqDocId}, #{reqDocTitle}, #{owner}, #{ownerUserId}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{startDate}, #{completedAt}, #{firstStartedAt}, #{lastEndedAt}, #{totalMinutes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), description = VALUES(description), req_id = VALUES(req_id), req_name = VALUES(req_name), req_doc_id = VALUES(req_doc_id), req_doc_title = VALUES(req_doc_title), owner = VALUES(owner), owner_user_id = VALUES(owner_user_id), category = VALUES(category), priority = VALUES(priority), start_date = VALUES(start_date), completed_at = VALUES(completed_at), first_started_at = VALUES(first_started_at), last_ended_at = VALUES(last_ended_at), total_minutes = VALUES(total_minutes)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_completion_record WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_completion_record WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
